metric_definitions.Recall@5: fraction of queries with at least one grade-2 DIRECT_SUPPORT result in top 5
metric_definitions.Precision@5: mean fraction of returned top-5 chunks with grade greater than zero
metric_definitions.nDCG@5: graded relevance using gains 2^grade-1 and log2 discount
metric_definitions.MRR: reciprocal rank of first grade-2 DIRECT_SUPPORT result
metric_definitions.citation_locator_validity: fraction of returned chunks whose displayed source locator is confirmed valid

claim_boundary: Prospective human-label protocol frozen after the machine proxy run but before any human relevance labels. A complete workbook may promote section-aware chunking for this synthetic handbook only; it cannot establish real-document, GraphRAG, diagnosis or Active-KG gain.
